title: Temporal Behavior Trees for Reinforcement Learning: Specifications as Rewards, Curricula, and Diagnostics
abstract: arXiv:2611.13993v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning from formal specifications often separates task definition, reward shaping, curriculum design, and policy diagnostics into different mathematical objects. This fragmentation requires additional conversion steps and discards structure already present in the specification, such as subtask boundaries, ordering constraints, and quantitative measures. We introduce TBTCL (Temporal Behavior Tree Centric Learning), a framework that uses Temporal Behavior Trees (TBTs) as a unified interface for specification-guided reinforcement learning. A single TBT specifies the task, induces dense robustness-based rewards, defines a curriculum, and supports better understanding of learned policies. By adapting TBT syntax and semantics for specification-guided reinforcement learning, we provide a formalism that is more expressive than popular specification languages such as LTL and inherently hierarchical. translated_title: 面向强化学习的时间行为树：规范作为奖励、课程与诊断工具
translated_abstract: 基于形式化规范的强化学习通常将任务定义、奖励塑形、课程设计与策略诊断分离为不同的数学对象。这种碎片化不仅需要额外的转换步骤，还会丢弃规范中已经存在的结构，例如子任务边界、顺序约束和定量度量。我们提出了TBTCL（时间行为树中心学习）框架，该框架将时间行为树（TBT）用作规范引导强化学习的统一接口。单个TBT即可指定任务、产生基于鲁棒性的密集奖励、定义课程，并支持对学习到的策略进行更好的理解。通过为规范引导强化学习适配TBT的语法与语义，我们提供了一种比LTL等流行规范语言更具表达力且天然层次化的形式化方法。我们提出了自动……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出TBTCL框架，以时间行为树（TBT）作为统一接口，使单一规范同时承担任务定义、密集鲁棒性奖励生成、课程设计与策略诊断四种功能，其表达力优于LTL且天然具有层次结构。
